metadata.description: NyayaAI Legal Source Metadata - Indian Law References
metadata.note: This file contains metadata about Indian legal sources. URLs point to official government sources where available. No verification dates are claimed unless actually verified.

sources.title: Constitution of India
sources.description: The supreme law of India, establishing the framework for government institutions, fundamental rights, directive principles, and duties of citizens.

sources.title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)
sources.description: New criminal code replacing the Indian Penal Code. Covers offenses, punishments, and criminal liability under Indian law.

sources.title: Indian Penal Code (IPC)
sources.description: Former primary criminal code of India, now replaced by Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita effective July 2024.

sources.title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
sources.description: New code of criminal procedure replacing CrPC. Governs the process of criminal investigation, trial, and appeals.

sources.title: Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC)
sources.description: Former procedural law for criminal cases, replaced by BNSS effective July 2024.

sources.title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA)
sources.description: New evidence act replacing the Indian Evidence Act. Governs admissibility of evidence in courts.

sources.title: Indian Contract Act
sources.description: Governs contracts in India including formation, performance, breach, and remedies.

sources.title: Consumer Protection Act
sources.description: Protects consumer rights, provides for consumer dispute redressal, and addresses unfair trade practices.

sources.title: Information Technology Act
sources.description: Primary law governing electronic commerce, cybercrime, and digital signatures in India.
sources.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

sources.title: Hindu Marriage Act
sources.description: Governs marriage and divorce for Hindus, Buddhists, Jains, and Sikhs in India.

sources.title: Transfer of Property Act
sources.description: Governs the transfer of property between living persons, including sale, mortgage, lease, and gift.

sources.title: Indian Succession Act
sources.description: Governs wills, intestate succession, and inheritance for non-Hindu populations.

sources.title: Hindu Succession Act
sources.description: Governs intestate succession among Hindus, providing for equal rights of sons and daughters.

sources.title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
sources.description: Protects women from domestic violence and provides remedies including protection orders and residence orders.
sources.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

sources.title: Right to Information Act (RTI)
sources.description: Provides citizens the right to access information from public authorities to promote transparency.

sources.title: Motor Vehicles Act
sources.description: Regulates motor vehicles, driving licenses, traffic rules, and accident claims.
sources.authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

sources.title: Negotiable Instruments Act
sources.description: Governs cheques, promissory notes, and bills of exchange. Section 138 covers cheque bounce cases.

sources.title: Specific Relief Act
sources.description: Provides specific remedies for breach of contract and recovery of property through injunctions and specific performance.

sources.title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act
sources.description: Governs arbitration, conciliation, and alternative dispute resolution in India.

sources.title: Code of Civil Procedure (CPC)
sources.description: Governs the procedure for civil litigation in India including suits, appeals, and execution of decrees.

sources.title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Workplace Act (POSH)
sources.description: Protects women from sexual harassment at workplace and mandates Internal Complaints Committee.
sources.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

sources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act
sources.description: Governs processing of digital personal data, data principal rights, and obligations of data fiduciaries.
sources.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
